02 / Brand history

HEKTOR® —
since 1961.

Heinrich Ektor started as a two-lathe workshop in Duisburg, bending copper for the mills along the Rhine. Sixty years later, HEKTOR® conductor rails carry current on every continent — and FERROTRACK is their official distribution partner in the region.

1961Workshop founded in Duisburg — first copper conductor rails for rolling-mill cranes.
1978ETP-grade copper becomes the company standard across all series.
1996HFP insulated platform launched — IP23 as the baseline protection class.
2011HFP56 sets a new class — 1 600 A on a single 4-pole line.
2024FERROTRACK confirmed as official distribution partner — certificate № HT-2011-014.
